# Web Application

## What this skill does
- Reads GOAL.md if present to capture mission, milestones, and constraints.
- Produces a production-ready builder prompt (stack, features, deployment).
- Lays out a 30-minute sprint project plan aligned to milestones.

## When to use
- Creating or refining prompts for AI web app builders.
- Planning Astro + Tailwind + Markdown blog projects for GitHub Pages.

## Procedure
1. Read GOAL.md in the workspace root if available.
2. Confirm stack: Astro + Tailwind + Markdown (Astro Content Collections).
3. List required features: hybrid project grid, GitHub metadata, external link safety, Tailwind typography, SEO meta-tags, and share links (GitHub repo and news sites).
4. Add production constraints: GitHub Pages base path, GitHub Actions deploy, responsive layout, performance, and accessibility.
5. Draft the optimized builder prompt with acceptance criteria and placeholders for base path and GitHub profile URL.
6. Provide a 30-minute sprint plan mapped to setup, layout, projects grid, content system, SEO/typography, and deployment.
7. Flag open decisions and missing inputs.

## Output format
- Section 1: Optimized builder prompt (ready to paste).
- Section 2: Project plan (30-minute sprints).
- Section 3: Open questions and placeholders.
